mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 6% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) of more than 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production of more than 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls > 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5% combined with a decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST) signals weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5% and HOUST falls for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 5% and HOUST falls for 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both fall for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS and HOUST both fall for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening manufacturing and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both fall for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO and RSAFS both fall for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
